arguments.summary: Privilege escalation attempt detected on host 10.0.1.25 (WS-IT-101) involving named pipe impersonation via winlogon.exe spawning cmd.exe with SYSTEM privileges. The compromised service account svc_deploy_prod was targeted and locked due to multiple failed authentication attempts. Investigation revealed lateral movement originating from host 10.0.5.42 (WS-FIN-042), which exhibited Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior. Critical detection gaps were identified in forensic access control and detection rule coverage for named pipe abuse.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Winlogon Spawning Cmd via Named Pipe Impersonation
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    Image: '*\\winlogon.exe'
  child:
    ParentImage: '*\\winlogon.exe'
    Image: '*\\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'pipe'
  condition: parent and child
level: critical
references:
  - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/secbp/impersonation-attacks
